set.body:
Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-18-best-recall-to-video-mapper.md §3 Phase 0 item 5.

build.sbt's checkAll runs scalafmtCheckAll first; sbt's ';' aborts on the first failure, so a whitespace nit hides a failing test (handoff §5 trap).

Scope:
Reorder the alias; update the documented trap.

Acceptance criteria:
1. checkAll runs compileAll and testAll before scalafmtCheckAll and scalafmtSbtCheck.
2. Demonstrated on a scratch branch: a deliberate formatting nit plus a deliberately failing test yields a reported test failure, not a formatting abort (log excerpt in the commit body).
3. The trap note in docs/plans/2026-09-17-one-point-oh-handoff.md §5 (and AGENTS.md if it names the alias) is updated.
4. `sbt githubWorkflowCheck` passes.

Gate (AGENTS.md SD2/SD6): `sbt -batch clean compileAll testAll` on the merge result, then
`sbt -batch scalafmtCheckAll scalafmtSbtCheck` as a separate run; every test task in build.sbt's
testAll alias reports bound totals (56 at 0e36a7fa, after the corpus modules were added; recount if
modules change); a named mutation witness per new guard, and each compile-time-probe mutation proved
after its own clean recompile; `cd docs-site && npm run verify:examples` when public API or examples
change; fresh-context cold review in a separate pass; the commit body states the evidence and what
it does not establish.

Size: S.
set.title: Phase 0: make the checkAll alias run correctness before formatting
